  - button "UI Component Architecture Proposal": UI Component Architecture Proposal▸
  - region:
    - heading "So, avem niste architecture Proposal" [level=1]
    - paragraph: "Dar nu e pentru UI, e pentru routing si domain. Ideea ii ca is doua feluri de a face aplicatie ca si a noastra:"
    - list:
      - strong: Subdomain Model
      - strong: Path-Based Model
    - paragraph:
      - text: Noi deocamdata folosim Path-Based Model, adica avem un singur domeniu, si in functie de path-ul URL-ului, afisam diferite pagini. Pentru a separa partea statica de partea de galactica app, o sa folosim un path
      - code: /app
      - text: pentru toate paginile
    - paragraph: Cealalata propunere ar fi sa avem partea statica pe un domeniu normal, si aplicatia pe un subdomeniu, gen app.galactica.com.
    - paragraph: Am avut o discutie cu prietenul nostru comun, si a facut o comparare intre modele, e sub textul asta. Am facut si eu o imagine frumoasa ca acompaniament.
    - 'heading "Frontend Architecture Comparison: Split-Subdomain vs Single-Domain Models" [level=1]'
    - separator
    - 'heading "📘 Model 1: Split-Subdomain Architecture (\"Subdomain Model\")" [level=2]'
    - heading "🌍 Domain Structure:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - code: www.yourwebsite.com
      - text: → Public site (landing, about, sign in, etc.)
      - code: app.yourwebsite.com
      - text: → Authenticated app (dashboards, products, storefronts)
    - heading "✅ Pros:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Clear separation of concerns (marketing vs app)
      - listitem: Independent deployment pipelines
      - listitem: Easier to optimize SEO and performance for the public site
      - listitem: More scalable for future features (e.g., mobile, international versions)
      - listitem: More professional SaaS-like experience
    - heading "❌ Cons:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: More complex setup (DNS, deployment, routing)
      - listitem: Cross-domain login/session handling may require cookie or token config
    - heading "🧱 Minimal Monorepo Folder Structure:" [level=3]
    - code: "creator-platform/ ├── apps/ │ ├── www/ # Public site (React or Next.js) │ ├── app/ # Creator/user dashboard app ├── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI components │ ├── auth/ # Shared auth logic │ ├── utils/ # Shared helpers"
    - separator
    - 'heading "📗 Model 2: Single-Domain with URL Prefix Architecture (\"Path-Based Model\")" [level=2]'
    - heading "🌍 Domain Structure:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - code: www.yourwebsite.com/
      - text: → Public site
      - code: www.yourwebsite.com/app/...
      - text: → Authenticated app (dashboard, library, etc.)
    - heading "✅ Pros:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Simpler deployment (single domain, single host or service)
      - listitem: Easier cookie/session management (no cross-domain issues)
      - listitem: Can be built as a single SPA (e.g., with route-based layout switching)
    - heading "❌ Cons:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Harder to decouple public site from app logic over time
      - listitem: All changes require a single redeploy
      - listitem: May cause confusion or route collision if not managed carefully
      - listitem: SEO tuning and page load performance harder to isolate
    - heading "🧱 Minimal Folder Structure (Single App):" [level=3]
    - code: "creator-platform/ ├── src/ │ ├── components/ │ ├── pages/ │ │ ├── index.jsx # Home │ │ ├── about.jsx │ │ ├── app/ │ │ │ ├── dashboard.jsx # Creator dashboard │ │ │ ├── library.jsx # Buyer dashboard │ │ │ ├── explore.jsx # Product discovery │ ├── layouts/ │ │ ├── PublicLayout.jsx │ │ ├── AppLayout.jsx ├── App.js or main.tsx"
    - separator
    - heading "🏁 Recommendation" [level=2]
    - list:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Choose
        - strong: Subdomain Model
        - text: "if:"
      - list:
        - listitem: You want cleaner codebase separation and professional SaaS UX
